stem.text: A transverse wave in a medium has the waveform shown, where
The speed of the wave is $20.0\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$.

stem.alt: Transverse waveform graph with vertical axis y/mm from -1.0 to +1.0 and horizontal axis x/cm from 0 to 8.0, showing a sine-shaped wave.

stem.text: A particle of the medium oscillates vertically.
Which graph of vertical displacement $y$ against time $t$ best represents the motion of this particle?

A.alt: Graph of y/mm against t/s with y from -1.0 to +1.0 and t/s up to 0.20, showing one sine-shaped curve.

B.alt: Graph of y/mm against t/s with y from -1.0 to +1.0 and t/s up to 4.0, showing one sine-shaped curve.

C.alt: Graph of y/mm against t/s with y from 0 to +2.0 and t/s up to 8.0, showing two identical arched curves.

D.alt: Graph of y/mm against t/s with y from 0 to +2.0 and t/s up to 10.0, showing two identical arched curves.
